entities.name: Query 94 aa Ppnp
observations: 94-aa protein; calculated molecular mass 10,085 Da, theoretical pI 4.39, and estimated charge at pH 7 of -6.48.
Contains a Ppnp Pfam domain (PF06865.18) spanning residues 3–93.
Shares 84.0% identity over 100% of the sequence with reviewed Klebsiella pneumoniae pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase A6T5B6.
Shares 81.9% identity over essentially full length with reviewed Enterobacter sp. pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase A4W766.
Function is therefore strongly inferred as a bacterial pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase, but exact substrate breadth is homology-based rather than directly tested for this sequence.
Likely cytosolic based on homolog annotations; no transmembrane segment or signal peptide is evident from the short sequence.

entities.name: A6T5B6
observations: Reviewed Klebsiella pneumoniae pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase; 84.0% identity and 100% query coverage to the query sequence.
Catalyzes reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to free bases and alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate; annotated EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.
Annotated as cytosolic with guanosine, thymidine, and uridine phosphorylase activities.

entities.name: Ppnp PF06865
observations: Pfam family Ppnp PF06865.18 matches query residues 3–93 with i-Evalue 4.5e-36.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: Representative reaction: purine D-ribonucleoside plus phosphate yields the corresponding purine base plus alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:19805.

Related homolog annotations include adenosine, cytidine, guanosine, inosine, thymidine, uridine, and xanthosine phosphorolysis, but exact substrate specificity for the query is not experimentally established.
